# v1.7.0 — Observability Coverage + ETL Wiring (CI-42–CI-48, R-05, R-17, R-19–R-21)

Released: 2026-05-26

## Added
- `CI-44` / `R-19`: Expand `unit-tests` CI job to cover `observability/` package. Coverage gate raised `60` → `65`.
- `R-05`: `tests/unit/test_anomaly_detection.py` — 24 unit tests covering all anomaly detection paths.
- `R-09`: `MASTER_ACTION_TRACKER.md` created as persistent in-repo tracker for architecture remediation items.
- `R-17`: `prometheus-client==0.21.1` pinned as explicit direct dependency (was transitive-only via `prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator`; direct pin required for supply-chain hygiene).

## Fixed
- `CI-42`: Align `opentelemetry-api` / `instrumentation-fastapi` to `sdk 1.42.1` / `0.62b0`.
- `CI-43`: Bump `opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi` `0.62b0` → `0.63b0`.
  > **Note:** `CI-42`/`CI-43` upgrade attempt to `1.42.1` stack was subsequently **reverted** in CI-44 — `instrumentation-fastapi 0.63b1` does not exist on PyPI; `ResolutionImpossible` on semantic-conventions mismatch. Final pinned stack: `api/sdk/exporter==1.41.1`, `instrumentation-fastapi==0.62b1`.
- `CI-45` / `R-20`: Wire `tests/unit/test_etl_validation.py` into CI `pytest` invocation. File existed since `R-06` (`90c241f`) but was never added to the CI command — 30 tests were silently skipped on every run.
- `R-21`: Add `--cov=pipelines` to unit-tests coverage scope. Gate raised `65` → `68`.
- `CI-46`: Align `pip-audit` `2.7.3` → `2.9.0` (matches `requirements-dev.txt`).
- `CI-47`: SHA-pin `codecov/codecov-action@v5`; closes `R-S03`.
- `CI-48`: Correct unit test paths from `tests/` → `tests/unit/` prefix.
